violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: opened/ portioned packaged commercially prepared RTE chopped grilled chicken and portioned sliced American cheese inside the True 2 Dr UR refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. CFM added date mark label of remaining 7-day hold to portioned commercially prepared grilled chicken and sliced American cheese inside the True 2 Dr UR refrigerator.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Observed pesticides (Raid insect spray) labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests stored on chemical shelf in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. CDI: CFM removed raid from the facility and instructed to discontinue usage.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: accumulation of debris on shelves and interior walls inside the True 2 Dr UR refrigerator in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EHS instructed CF to clean the interior walls and shelves inside the True 2 Dr UR refrigerator.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling tile missing the Penn walk in refrigerator and is not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS instructed CFM to repair/ replace ceiling tile.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. CFM DIDN’T WASH HANDS AFTER CRACKING EGGS AND BEFORE COOKING.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS EDUCATED THE CFM.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. DRINKS WERE STORED ON FLOOR IN DRY STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS EDUCATED THE CFM.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. EHS EDUCATED CFM.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of @FOOD@. A MANUFACTURER CONTAINER OF TZATZIKI SAUCE WAS USED TO STORE SLICED HAM AND SLICED TURKEY IN KRATOS 2-DOOR PREP COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. CFM DISCARDED THE MANUFACTURER CONTAINER.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: An air gap between the water supply outlet and the flood rim level @EQUIPMENT@ is not observed. NO AIR GAP WAS OBSERVED UNDER THE WASH BASIN AND RINSE BASIN AT 3-COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. PLEASE CREATE AN AIR GAP FOR THE WASH BASIN AND RINSE BASIN WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: COOKED CHICKEN WAS THAWING ON THE TOP OF STEAM TABLE FOR ABOUT 1 HOUR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CFM PUT THE FOOD ITEM IN REACH IN COOLER. KIDWELL CAFE (Inspection Date: 04/03/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Air Gap Provided
violations.observation: Observed a hose attached to a faucet fixture. The hose extended below the flood rim level of the sink basin.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by providing an air gap as specified under 5-202.13. CFM WILL NEED TO CUT THE HOSE A MINIMUM OF ONE INCH ABOVE THE FLOOD RIM.
